title: Stacking and Switching (Michelle Grogan)
style: sung upbeat pop 116 bpm punchy acoustic guitar funky bass tight drums horn stab call-and-response light Spanish phrase accent team-energy pickleball training song artist Michelle Grogan
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Forehand wants the middle backhand to the side
Stack and switch to keep the strong shot wide
Call it loud call it clear yours mine switch
The partner hears every word every pitch

[Pre-Chorus]
Yours mine switch yours
Communication wins the wars

[Chorus]
Stacking and switching
Doubles is a system not a wishing
Talk it out keep it twitching
Stacking and switching

[Verse 2]
Server side returner side know your spot
After the serve switch back to the slot
Poach when the lob is high and short
And the partner covers the open court

[Bridge]
Tú yo cambio listo el plan
Doubles está the team is the man
Grita gritar talk it through
That's how the doubles trophy comes to you

[Chorus]
Stacking and switching
Doubles is a system not a wishing
Talk it out keep it twitching
Stacking and switching

[Outro]
Two paddles one mind clean
Stacking and switching is the team machine
